name: Dr. Vikas Verma
headline: Board Certified Plastic Surgeon in Dubai
lede: Discover advanced cosmetic and reconstructive treatments with Dr. Vikas Verma, Dubai’s leading board-certified plastic surgeon.
services: Dr Vikas Kumar Varma Ms, M.Ch, Mrcs(Uk)
about: Dr. Vikas Kumar Verma is internationally acclaimed and well-known plastic and cosmetic surgeon. He has done his medical school (MBBS) from the prestigious JIPMER, Pondicherry. He has received his training in Plastic and Cosmetic Surgery at the reputed Grant Medical College and Sir JJ Group of Hospitals, Mumbai and graduated with a gold medal.

Face surgery is done to improve a person’s facial appearance and, thus, self-esteem.
